game.title: The Last Bunker
game.subtitle: Survive. Build. Endure.
hud.bunkerFull: No free beds – build or upgrade Quarters so more survivors can come
build.title: Build
build.demolishConfirm: Tear this room down? Its workers go idle and you get back half of its build cost.
build.demolishIncident: Can't demolish during a crisis in this room
build.demolishBeds: Can't demolish: people would be left without a bed
building.bedsCapped: Your rooms give {built} beds, but this Act holds the bunker to {cap} people. The next Act opens more room.
building.digForHomes: No room left for new quarters. Upgrade these (+3 beds a level) or dig a deeper level for more homes.
people.title: Survivors
toast.no_food: Out of food! Survivors are starving – build a Farm and assign workers
toast.no_water: Out of water! Build a Water Pump and assign a worker
event.wanderer.title: Knocking at the Door
event.wanderer.desc: A starving wanderer named {name} stands at the bunker door, begging for shelter.
event.stash.title: Hidden Stash
event.stash.desc: A survivor found an old crate full of parts behind a loose wall panel.
event.stash.result.take: The storage room fills up a little.
event.pipeLeak.title: Burst Pipe!
event.pipeLeak.desc: A main pipe near the water pump has burst. Water is flooding the floor.
event.pipeLeak.result.ignore: Part of the water reserve is gone.
event.argument.title: Argument
event.argument.desc: {nameA} and {nameB} are shouting at each other over ration shares.
event.argument.result.mediate: They shake hands. The mood in the bunker improves.
event.trader.title: Wandering Trader
event.trader.desc: A trader with a rusty cart stops by the entrance. "I've got goods, if you've got something to offer."
event.trader.result.decline: The trader shrugs and moves on.
event.trader.choice.tradeBlueprint: Materials and scrap for a blueprint
event.trader.result.tradeBlueprint: A real blueprint, rolled up in oilcloth. Worth every bolt.
event.powerSurge.title: Power Surge
event.powerSurge.desc: The generator is making a strange noise and the lights flicker.
event.powerSurge.choice.shutdown: Shut down for inspection (lose stored power)
event.powerSurge.choice.risk: Keep it running, it'll be fine
event.powerSurge.result.shutdown: Inspection passed. The batteries are drained.
event.powerSurge.result.riskGood: The noise settles. The gamble paid off.
event.sickness.title: Sickness
event.sickness.desc: {name} wakes up with a high fever and a cough.
event.sickness.result.rest: {name} is weakened, but will recover in time.
event.radioSignal.title: Radio Static
event.radioSignal.desc: Through the static, a faint voice: "...if anyone can hear... we are not alone..." Then silence.
event.radioSignal.result.listen: There are others out there. But who?
welcome.converted: Storage was full, so the overflow became {credits} Trade credits:
welcome.absorbed: The overflow went to the active project first:
welcome.convertedHint: Spend credits in the shop in the journal, or expand storage to keep more.
shop.intro: Overflow that doesn't fit in storage turns into credits. Trade them for things that are hard to find.
shop.ramp: Each purchase makes the same item 10% dearer until midnight.
shop.item.scrap20.desc: Raw material that only comes from outside.
shop.item.researchBoost.desc: Finishes 10 minutes of the active research at once.
shop.item.isotope.desc: For Genesis upgrades. Limited per week.
shop.item.crate.desc: Another crate on top of the daily one.
welcome.title: Welcome Back, Overseer
welcome.wasted: Thrown away because storage was full:
welcome.wastedHint: Build or upgrade a Storage room to keep more while you're away.
welcome.door: {n} people are waiting at the door: {names}. They have been waiting since the night.
welcome.doorOne: {names} is waiting at the door, since the night. Let them in?
welcome.doorBeds: Only {n} free beds. The rest will have to move on.
supply.title: Supply Drop
supply.desc: A crate on a parachute landed by the hatch. Someone out there still remembers Bunker 17.
supply.full: Storage is full, so most of it had to stay outside.
supply.tomorrow: Come back tomorrow: the crate grows every day in a row, and every 7th day it holds a blueprint.
settings.notifyBlockedHint: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in the browser or phone settings.
settings.notifyOn: Notifications on: up to 3 a day, only while you're away.
notify.expedition.title: The team is back
notify.expedition.body: Your expedition made it home with its haul. Come see what they found.
notify.research.title: Research complete
notify.research.body: {name} is ready. Time to pick the next project.
notify.storage.title: Storage is full
notify.storage.body: No more room for {res}. The extra is going to waste: spend it or build Storage.
notify.door.title: Someone at the door
notify.door.body: A newcomer is waiting to be let in.
research.title: Research
research.idle: No active research – pick a topic
research.needLab: Build a Laboratory (Engineering level) to produce knowledge and speed up research
research.queueHint: Queued research is paid now and keeps going on its own, even while you are away
research.refineHint: Repeatable: every level adds 5%, costs more and takes longer
surface.title: The Surface
surface.locked: Without hazmat suits, leaving the bunker is suicide. Research "Hazmat Suits" to send expeditions.
surface.pickHex: Pick a hex on the map to send an expedition
surface.home: Home. This is where it all began.
surface.teamOut: A team is already heading here
rush.gift: +{n} rush charges: each cuts 15 minutes off a build, research or expedition
surface.noTeam: No free survivors: everyone is posted to a station or too hurt (health 25 and below)
surface.leavesJob: Workers on an expedition won't work until they return
surface.teamsFull: All teams are out. Wait for one to come home.
surface.needsVehicles: Too far to walk. Research Vehicles to reach the outer rings.
surface.longHint: Long haul: 6× the time, 4× the loot. Good before a long break.
mission.title: Expedition Returned
mission.success: The expedition to the {place} returned successfully!
mission.failure: The expedition to the {place} ran into trouble and came back nearly empty-handed.
menu.title: Menu
settings.pasteHere: Your save code appears here, or paste one to load
settings.newGameConfirm: The current game will be replaced by a brand-new one, including Isotope-7 and Genesis upgrades. A last backup of the current game is kept and can be restored from Settings > Backups until the next big action. It is also worth exporting your save to a file.
settings.newGameDone: New game started. Good luck, Overseer.
genesis.isotope: Isotope-7 – kept forever, even after rebirth
genesis.explain: Project Genesis sends everything you learned into the past. The bunker restarts from scratch, but you earn Isotope-7 for permanent upgrades that make every run stronger.
genesis.ready: Every requirement is met – you can start over
genesis.confirmBody: The bunker, survivors, research and map will reset. You will receive {n} Isotope-7. Achievements and permanent upgrades are kept.
building.radio: Broadcasting to the wasteland: wanderers arrive more often and events happen more frequently
building.training: Trainees gain triple XP and level up fast
event.radioSignal2.title: A Reply on the Frequency
event.radioSignal2.desc: The radio room picks up the voice again. "This is Facility Genesis. If you hear us – there is hope. We are sending you a blueprint."
event.radioSignal2.result.reply: You received a blueprint and new knowledge. Who are "Genesis"?
event.radioSignal3.title: Coordinates
event.radioSignal3.desc: The final broadcast: a string of numbers, then a scream. The coordinates point somewhere far out in the wasteland.
event.radioSignal3.result.mark: The Genesis Vault is marked on the surface map. It is far and dangerous.
event.raiders.title: Raiders!
event.raiders.desc: An armed raider gang (strength {strength}) approaches the bunker door demanding a "toll".
event.raiders.result.fightWin: The raiders fled in panic and left gear behind!
event.raiders.result.fightLose: The raiders broke through, grabbed scrap and hurt the defenders. Some are still inside on the top floor: drive them out!
event.raiders.result.tribute: The raiders took the food and scrap and left. For now.
dig.title: Dig level B{n}
dig.body: Digging deeper opens a new level. Deep levels accept any type of room.
dig.done: Level B{n} excavated! Room for new rooms
dig.needStorageBody: Your storage holds only {cap} {res}, but this dig costs {cost}. Build or upgrade a Storage Room first.
ruin.noCrew: No crew. Add survivors to make progress
ruin.restoresInto: Restoring brings it back as a working {name} (level 1)
ruin.somethingHidden: Something is hidden here... maybe a note from the previous residents
ruin.needsPump: A working water pump is needed to drain the water
ruin.noIdle: No idle survivors. You can start now and assign someone later
ruin.startedNoCrew: Work site opened. Assign a survivor to make progress
journal.title: Journal
journal.intro: What the 41 residents of Bunker 17 left behind.
journal.empty: Nothing found yet. Clear the ruins to discover more.
journal.missing: {n} more pieces are waiting to be found
era.title: Command
era.final: You have reached the final era. The city is yours.
intro.title: The Last Bunker
intro.firstHint: Everything is dark. Start by restoring the generator on B3
drag.noJobs: There is no work in this room
tip.drag: Tip: press and hold a survivor, then drag them onto a room to assign them
incident.started: {name} in {room}! Tap the alarm to help
spec.title: Room specialization
spec.hint: The room is at its top level. Choose a special role for it; the choice is final.
family.none: No families yet. Happy residents fall in love over time.
family.grownUp: {name} has grown up and is ready to work
exp.j.depart: A team of {n} left the bunker.
district.title: Side Tunnel
district.body: The crew will break a tunnel through the east wall of B{floor}, into the hollow that echoes beyond it.
settings.gfxHint: High: the screen's full sharpness, full light effects and film grain, smooth even when idle (warmer). Medium (phone default): sharp, lighter effects, rests when you are not touching. Battery saver: cool and light.
toast.liteMode: The game closed unexpectedly a few times, so lite mode is on. Change it in Settings > Graphics
incident.burnout: {name} in {room} burned itself out, after doing its damage
danger.raid.title: Raiders incoming!
danger.raid.body: The lookout spotted a raider gang heading for the door. Raider strength: {strength}. Our defense: {defense}. They arrive in {time}.
danger.raid.hintWeak: Our defense is weaker than theirs. Post guards at the armory, or pay the toll and avoid the fight.
danger.raid.hintOk: Our defense is stronger than theirs. If we hold the door we get loot.
danger.disaster.crew: It takes {n} free people to handle
danger.disaster.noCost: Not enough resources to handle it
danger.toast.raid: A lookout saw raiders! They arrive in {time}
raid.title: The raiders arrived
raid.result.win: The door held. The raiders fled and left gear behind.
raid.result.winCaptive: The door held. One of them stayed behind and asks to join us: {captive}.
raid.result.loseSmall: The raiders broke in, took scrap and hurt defenders. Some are still on the top floor: drive them out!
raid.result.loseBig: A rout. The raiders took the entrance, grabbed scrap and hurt many defenders. Some are still inside.
raid.result.tribute: The raiders took the toll and left. For now.
memorial.title: The bunker lost {name}
memorial.line.hydroponics: Grew greens in the dark so we would have something to eat.
memorial.line.waterPump: Kept the water coming, day after day.
memorial.line.waterPurifier: Made sure our water stayed clean.
memorial.line.reactor: Worked by the reactor, where nobody else wanted to.
memorial.line.reactorHall: Worked in the heart of the reactor, where nobody else wanted to.
memorial.line.storage: Counted every crate in the storeroom, and knew each one.
memorial.line.medbay: Treated the wounded and never asked for thanks.
memorial.line.workshop: Fixed everything that broke in the bunker.
memorial.line.canteen: Cooked warm meals through the hard days.
memorial.line.trainingRoom: Taught others how to hold on.
memorial.line.laboratory: Searched for answers among the books and instruments.
memorial.line.radioTower: Listened to the radio through the nights, and never gave up on a voice.
memorial.line.armory: Stood at the door when the raiders came.
memorial.line.quarters: Looked after everyone who came back tired to the quarters.
memorial.line.batteryBank: Tended the power cells, so there was light even in the long nights.
memorial.line.commons: Knew how to make us laugh on the hard evenings.
memorial.line.library: Guarded the books, and not one page was lost.
memorial.line.recycler: Turned junk into things we could build with.
memorial.line.condenser: Pulled water for us out of the air itself.
memorial.line.mushroomFarm: Grew mushrooms in the dark, and found us food there.
memorial.line.gatePost: Kept the gate at night, so the rest of us could sleep.
memorial.line.generic: Was part of this home from the first day.
memorial.hint: You can hold a short ceremony, or carry on.
memorial.ceremonyHint: A shared meal. Shorter mourning, then a lift in morale.
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.hint: A worn room breaks down more often. An engineer on the crew slows the wear.
maintenance.hintHot: High wear on a reactor risks a meltdown.
welcome.danger.title: While you were away:
welcome.danger.hint: A long absence brings injuries, but almost never deaths.
notify.raid.title: ⚠️ Raiders on the way
notify.raid.body: A raid is closing in on the bunker. There is still time to react.
notify.disaster.title: 🚨 {name}
notify.disaster.body: The crew is waiting for orders before it is too late.
event.group.title: Two at the Door
event.group.desc: {name} and {nameB} crossed the wasteland together and ask to come in. They won't be separated.
event.group.result.one: {name} came in. {nameB} walked on alone into the storm.
event.group.result.refuse: Two sets of footsteps fade away...
event.refugees.title: An Open Door
event.refugees.desc: The bunker is silent and empty. Then footsteps on the stairs: {name} and {nameB} found the open door, with a pack of food and water.
proj.title: Big Projects
proj.intro: Long goals for the colony. Every stage needs resources and a crew, and every finished stage pays a lasting reward. {done} of {all} stages done.
coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.intro: Pick how much to add on each line and press "Add". Come back any time with the same code.
coupon.nothing: Nothing to use this on right now
coupon.research.on: The active research and the queue ({n}). Leftover time goes to the next one
coupon.build.on: {n} rooms being built or upgraded, all of them shortened
coupon.dig.on: Digging floor B{n}, about {h} hours of full-crew work left
coupon.project.on: The active project: each stage is finished with its resources and work
coupon.missions.on: {n} expeditions out (radio calls are never skipped)
coupon.arrival.full: No free beds: nobody comes until there is room
coupon.fill.hint: Every resource up to its storage cap
proj.fedHint: The active project gets the overflow your storage can't hold first, even while you are away.
weekly.title: This week's challenge
weekly.prize: Prize: {n} credits and a collectible badge · {cur}/{target}
weekly.won: Weekly challenge done! You got {n} credits
trade.title: Trade with partners
trade.none: Nobody to trade with yet. Keep going with the story: friendship with Terminus, the Clan or Noa's people opens a road.
trade.next: {n} more deals to the next level
trade.out: Caravan on the road, back in {t}
trade.hint: A caravan is {n} people and a load from storage. Every deal improves relations; an ambush loses the cargo.
trade.home: The caravan from {name} is home safe
trade.ambush: The caravan to {name} was ambushed and the cargo is lost
welcome.doorNoBeds: No free beds. They will have to move on.
save.problem.error.title: We couldn't open your save
save.problem.error.body: The browser could not read its storage. Your progress has not been deleted, and the game will not write over it. Try again. If it keeps happening, close other tabs of the game or restart the phone.
save.problem.corrupt.title: Your save file is damaged
save.problem.corrupt.body: A save exists but cannot be read, and there is no usable backup. The file has been set aside and is not deleted: you can copy it and send it for repair. Or you can start a new game.
save.problem.unsaved: The game is not being saved right now. Saving returns after a reload.
save.recovered.title: Save restored from a backup
save.recovered.body: The main save file was damaged, so a backup ({kind}) from {time} was loaded. Progress since then may be lost. The damaged file was set aside.
save.failed: Saving failed. Storage may be full. Export your save from Settings so nothing is lost.
save.superseded.title: The game is open in another window
save.superseded.body: To avoid overwriting your progress, this window stopped saving. Carry on in the other window, or use this one instead.
settings.backups.confirm: Restore the game from {time}? The current game will be kept as the "before the last big action" backup.
settings.backups.hint: The game keeps a backup at the start of every session, one every half hour of play, and one before a new game, import, Genesis or restore.
settings.exportedFile: File created. Keep it somewhere safe.
settings.importConfirm: Load this save? The current game will be replaced and kept as the "before the last big action" backup, which you can restore from Settings.
settings.persistHint: If storage is not protected, the browser may delete the game when the phone runs low on space or after weeks unused. Add the game to your home screen and export a backup now and then.
a11y.hapticsHint: Short taps when you build, collect, or make a mistake. On iPhone this needs iOS 17.4 or newer.
a11y.playInSilentHint: iPhone: keep the game sound on even when the silent switch is on.
a11y.motionHint: Calms camera shake and impact effects. Auto follows your phone's setting.
a11y.title: Accessibility and comfort
orient.title: Turn your phone upright
orient.hint: The game is made for a phone held upright. You can carry on like this in a compact layout: resources on the left, navigation on the right.
a11y.oneHandHint: Moves the close button of panels and the objective strip to your thumb's side.
a11y.largeTargetsHint: Every button at least 52 pixels, with more space between them.
settings.notifyWebHint: In the browser version, notifications only arrive while the game stays open in the background. They will work fully in the phone app.
traitDesc.loner: +25% when working alone in a room
inbox.title: Decisions
inbox.empty: Nothing waits for a decision. The bunker runs itself for now.
inbox.missionAsks: An expedition team asks what to do
inbox.reportOk: Expedition report: the team is back
inbox.expired: No answer in time: "{name}", the bunker chose "{choice}"
inbox.expiredItem: No answer in time: "{name}" took its safe default
difficulty.title: How hard is the world out there?
difficulty.body: Warden is the game as it was meant to be played. The choice holds for this bunker.
difficulty.settler.desc: Gentler raids, people eat less, more supplies at the start. Nobody dies while you are away.
difficulty.warden.desc: The intended balance: real danger, fair warnings, time to react.
difficulty.last.desc: Hungrier people, stronger raiders, fewer supplies. Time away is truly dangerous.
dig.started: Digging B{n} has begun ({t} with a full crew)
dig.eta: At this pace the new level opens in {t}.
dig.noCrewBody: Nobody is digging: the work has stopped.
dig.takes: Takes {t} of work for a crew of {n} (they leave their rooms meanwhile).
act.limits: This Act: rooms up to level {level} · up to {people} people · down to B{floors}
act.opens: Rooms can now reach level {level}, the bunker holds up to {people} people, and you may dig down to B{floors}.
genesis.reqAct: Finish the last Act (its charter ends with the Genesis Core)
building.actCap: Level {level} opens in a later Act
spec.retoolBody: The room stops for {t} while it is refitted. It costs twice a specialization.
foreman.title: Foreman: standing orders
foreman.hint: Routine the Foreman handles about once a minute, also while you are away.
foreman.deposit: Deliver spare goods to the active project
foreman.staff: Put idle people to work (the dig first)
foreman.allOff: All orders are off. Tap "Off" to turn one on.
foreman.report.maintainShort: Last round: {n} worn rooms, not enough resources to service them
foreman.report.maintainIdle: Last round: no worn rooms (40% or more)
foreman.report.deposited: Last round: delivered {n} units to the project
foreman.report.depositIdle: Last round: nothing spare that the project needs
foreman.report.staffed: Last round: put {n} people to work
foreman.report.staffFull: Last round: people are idle but no room has a free place
foreman.report.staffIdle: Last round: everyone is already working
raid.kind.scavengers: Scout report: a big band of scavengers. Walls and a strong door stop them best.
raid.kind.marauders: Scout report: a few hardened marauders. Only guards at the armory stop them well.
raid.stance.hide.desc: Nobody is hurt, but they take what they find in the stores
raid.stance.sally.set: Orders: the guards go out to meet them
raid.stance.hide.set: Orders: everyone below, let them take what they want
raid.result.hidden: Everyone waited below until they left. Nobody was hurt, but the stores are lighter.
raid.result.wrecked: They wrecked the {room}: restore it to get it back as it was.
season.title: Season
research.doctrine: Doctrine: choosing it closes the other paths of this choice for this run
research.eureka.floors: Eureka at {n} levels: cheaper and faster
research.eureka.lore: Eureka after {n} finds from the old residents
res.atCap: Storage is full: the extra turns into trade credits or feeds the active project.
res.why: Why the top producer makes what it makes
next.title: Next up
contract.title: Contract: {issuer}
contract.body: They ask: {ask}. They pay: {reward}. The offer lapses if nobody answers in time (nothing is lost).
outpost.title: Outpost
outpost.claimHint: Takes {t} to build. It sends home a share of the Act's goods and what this ground holds. Outposts: {n}/{max}.
outpost.damaged: Raiders wrecked it: it sends nothing until repaired.
outpost.block.taken: There is already an outpost here
outpost.hit: Raiders hit an outpost: repair it on the surface map
ending.kicker: The end of this world's story
ending.next: Project Genesis is open: the next world can begin.
laws.title: Laws ({n}/{slots})
genesis.keystone: Keystone: one per group, for every run to come
genesis.keystoneClosed: Closed: another keystone of this group was chosen
mutators.title: A new world, new hardships?
mutators.body: Take on hardships for this run and earn more Legacy at its Genesis. Now: +{n}%.
guide.researchBusy: Research under way, the next one done in {t2} ({c}/{t})
guide.digCrew: Put {n} more people on the dig crew
guide.digStorage: The next dig needs more {res} than storage holds: build or upgrade Storage
guide.digSave: Save up for the next dig: {cost}
guide.popBeds: The bunker is full: build quarters for the newcomers
guide.pop: Welcome {n} more survivors (the door brings them over time)
guide.outposts: Build {n} more outposts on the surface
guide.influence: Gather influence: build a Council Hall (a Canteen specialty)
guide.projCrew: {name}: put {n} more people on the crew
guide.genesis: Project Genesis is ready: Menu, Genesis tab
command.actDone: Everything this Act asks for is done: the next Act begins in a moment
command.forecastHint: At today's rates, with nothing else changing. Full stores waste what the rooms still make (some of it feeds the active project).
command.endingsHint: When the last Act is done, the story closes the way this run was lived. The highest score wins.
foreman.train: Quick-train the most experienced workers (needs a Training Room)
foreman.contracts: Answer the safe contracts (they cost nothing you would miss)
foreman.report.trainSaving: Last round: saving knowledge (under half of storage)
foreman.report.trainIdle: Last round: nobody can rank up right now
foreman.report.contractsWait: Last round: contracts wait for you (not safe to take on their own)
book.title: The Bunker Book
chronicle.title: Chronicle
chronicle.intro: Day {days} of this world · {n} milestones so far.
chronicle.empty: Nothing here yet. The first milestones will be written as you go.
chronicle.raidLost: A raid broke through the defense
sys.inbox.title: New: the Decisions inbox
sys.inbox.body: Decisions that can wait no longer pop up. They arrive here as cards, with a time limit and a safe default if you do not answer. Emergencies and the story still open by themselves.
sys.foreman.title: New: the Foreman
sys.foreman.body: Hand routine to standing orders: servicing, delivering spare goods to the project, placing idle people, quick training, answering safe contracts. They run about once a minute, also while you are away. The orders are in the Command panel (the flag at the top).
sys.contracts.title: New: contracts
sys.contracts.body: Partners outside post offers in the inbox: a scarce good or a crew for a few hours, for the Act's currency. Safe ones can be taken in one tap, or by the Foreman. An offer that lapses costs nothing.
sys.seasons.title: New: the seasons
sys.seasons.body: Four seasons of about four days each change output and danger. The icon at the top shows the current one: tap it for the forecast.
sys.doctrines.title: A doctrine can be chosen
sys.doctrines.body: Some research is a fork: pick one path and the others close. The choice shapes the bunker, and the ending of the run. Look for the doctrine mark in the research tree.
sys.outposts.title: New: outposts
sys.outposts.body: Claim explored hexes on the surface map. Each one produces every hour, also while you are away. Raids can damage them; you repair them, you do not lose them.
sys.laws.title: New: laws
sys.laws.body: You have a law slot. A law is a trade: more output for less morale, more defense for less freedom. You can repeal it later. Laws are in the Command panel.
sys.currency.title: A new currency: {name}
sys.currency.body: From this Act, prices are mostly in {name}. A room specialized for it makes it (see the room's panel), and the Book explains the late resources.
ending.choose.title: Which ending is yours?
ending.choose.body: The last Act is done, and more than one ending fits how you played: {list}. Choose how the story closes. If you do not answer in time, the best fit is told. Genesis settles it too.
scenario.title: Where does the next world begin?
scenario.body: The bunker you just finished stays on as a home and sends part of its income to the new one. Pick a place: each has its own rules, and its own lean toward an ending.
home.title: Homes
home.hint: Bunkers of earlier timelines. From Act II each sends part of an hour of income home, every hour.
home.line: {name} · reached {act} · sends {pct}% of an hour of income each hour
proj.design: Choose a design (until the first stage is done):
proj.designLocked: Design (fixed once the first stage is built):
guide.projStartDesign: Start the {name} project (Projects): you choose one of two designs
